dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two datasets were used: the Healthy dataset from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University, and the Clinical dataset from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The healthy dataset included 409 healthy control (HC) participants (HCtrain group) recruited from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University. The clinical dataset consisted of 324 individuals... 164 HC participants (HCtest group). These participants were recruited from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital."

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): normative training (Healthy dataset) / replicate validation and individualized evaluation for clinical research (Clinical dataset)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The Healthy dataset (HCtrain) was used to establish the normative reference. The Clinical dataset (HCtest and patients) was used for replicate validation and to evaluate individualized functional alterations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We set the HCtrain group as the training sample to establish the normative reference, and the testing sample that comprised the clinical dataset (HCtest group) was positioned on the normative percentile charts for replicate validation and individualized evaluation."
